 Tait Reynolds injured against Georgia Tech
 Tait Reynolds injured against Georgia Tech
 Tony Crumpton  ·  Assoc. Editor  ·  23 minutes ago 23 min ago 
 ios_share Share 
 f 
 X 
 SMS 
 @ 
 Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds suffered an apparent left ankle injury during the first quarter of Saturday's game against Georgia Tech in Death Valley.
 Reynolds appeared to get injured while sliding on the Tigers' third offensive snap. He limped noticeably after the play, and Clemson's medical staff looked at his ankle.
 The quarterback eventually walked off the field with assistance from trainers before heading to the medical tent for further evaluation.
 The severity of Reynolds' injury is currently unknown, and we will update you as we learn more.
 Backup quarterback Trent Pearman entered the game for Reynolds.
 Veteran Christopher Vizzina reportedly didn't take any snaps at practice this week after suffering a high ankle sprain last Monday.
 Update 1: Reynolds is heading to the locker room.
 Tait kinda jogged into the locker room, but with a heavy limp.
